comment: The Missing Diplomat (issue #38): a Human chain that the Alliance spine shares (Shared_Alliance.lua). Chains only: Route_Human.lua keeps the Human route and its RouteInfo. Every name, level, giver and point comes from the facts.

chains.name: The Missing Diplomat
chains.summary: Thomas in Stormwind City starts the search for the missing diplomat. The trail runs through Stormwind City, Duskwood and the Wetlands to Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Dustwallow Marsh.
